items.title: Jerome Richardson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: Guess who it was? Cannonball Adderley. And that’s how we all connected up to do his first album and so forth.

ctx.x: Right. You needed the gig. When did the quartet with, was it Oscar Pettiford, come about?

Oh, those days were also before the Roxy. I came in town, when I came in town I met Oscar Pettiford, oh, some years back in San Francisco. And I heard he was working at the Bohemia, so I went there, you know, went by there, and we talked a while and he said, “You want a gig?” I said, “Yeah.” He said, “I need a saxophone player.” I said, “You got one.” So I started playing there with him. And I always have to tell this story, because it is, I think it’s a funny one. One time, finally, I was doing a little bit of…
